name: Purshottam Investofin Limited
about: Purshottam Investofin Limited, a non-banking financial company, engaged in the business of financing and dealing in securities market in India. The company is involved in trading securities; lending business; and provides loans and advances. It also engages in investment in shares, securities, and other related activities. Purshottam Investofin Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in New Delhi, India.
